craft_notes: Sthāyin: turn-joy. Fixed 'heart'→'body' (L3 import repaired). Close: body. Rejected: 'ignorant' flat — 'rite-blind' kept; 'soul' — killed: body kept.

lines: Rite-blind, rule-wise, he turns to worship's art —
time-fire made first, through māyā's end, in brahma-body.
l4.sanskrit_cite: avidhijño vidhānajño jāyate yajanaṃ prati | kālāgnim āditaḥ kṛtvā māyāntam brahmadehagam

reads_against.argmap: Rite-unknowing, ordinance-knowing becomes toward worship — time-fire through māyā to brahma-body.
c1_essence: Rite-unknowing, ordinance-knowing turns; time-fire to brahma-body.
